_about: VEE-F 26: the steering wheel's screen (generic_lcd, its UVs a tile over: uv_wrap) shows the middle of its own picture (LCDMAC26, 1024 px, rows ~207 to 817): a STRAT row of 25 empty boxes and the gear's two big green digits painted fully lit. Made live: the gear in green where the painted digits were (covered), the revs filling the STRAT boxes (red near the limiter), the speed and the lap time in the empty top half. Pixels of that picture.
